# `gonogo suggest`, held out in time (generated by `python -m eval.suggest_heldout`)

Requirements that an older F´ release left uncited by their own component's tests and that developers cited by the dataset commit (`6fff089e8e`): 10 (v3.4.0: 8; v4.0.0: 2; v4.4.2: 0). In 6 of them the citation went into test code written after that release, which no ranking of the old code can find. The other 4 are scored below: `suggest` ranks the old release's test code, and the answer is the test body or helper where the macro was later written.

| Ranking | hit@1 | hit@3 | hit@5 | MRR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| suggest | 0.00 | 0.50 | 0.75 | 0.28 |
| random | 0.01 | 0.02 | 0.04 | 0.04 |

| Release | Requirement | Component | Later cited at | hit@1 | hit@3 |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| v3.4.0 | `ISF-CMDS-003` | `Svc/CmdSequencer` | `fn:parameterizedAutoByCommand` | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| v3.4.0 | `ISF-CMDS-004` | `Svc/CmdSequencer` | `fn:parameterizedFailedCommands` | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| v3.4.0 | `ISF-CMDS-005` | `Svc/CmdSequencer` | `fn:parameterizedCancel` | 0.00 | 1.00 |
| v3.4.0 | `ISF-CMDS-006` | `Svc/CmdSequencer` | `fn:parameterizedSequenceTimeout` | 0.00 | 1.00 |

With 4 scorable requirements this is far too small a sample to estimate accuracy: F´ rarely adds a citation to an existing requirement later. Read it as an anecdote next to the same-code measurement in [SUGGEST_RESULTS.md](SUGGEST_RESULTS.md).
